oneOf.description: SM-01-01 — ROLE-002; Verified contact, supported taxonomy, service notice acknowledged. Freeze intake revision; enqueue qualification
SM-01-02 — ROLE-011; Authority and eligibility evidence checked under pinned policy. Record reviewer and eligibility reasons
SM-01-03 — ROLE-011; Duplicate or authority conflict documented. Prevent booking/publication until resolved
SM-01-04 — ROLE-006; Confirmed appointment and verified seller scope. Link appointment and inspection work to the SellerLead; no TransactionCase exists until a current offer is accepted
SM-01-05 — ROLE-011; Reason and support route supplied. Notify owner without exposing duplicate identities
SM-01-06 — ROLE-002; Own case and no live binding obligation. Release future booking through idempotent scheduling command
SM-01-07 — ROLE-006; Verified completed transaction outcome or explicit unsuccessful/withdrawn selling outcome with no unresolved obligation. Record outcome, never infer financial success
SM-02-01 — ROLE-002; Own case, new slot valid, capacity and notice policy checked. Lock old/new slots in sorted ID order and move reservation atomically
SM-02-02 — ROLE-002; Own case and cancellation policy allows action. Release reservation exactly once; create notification intent
SM-02-03 — ROLE-006; Assigned branch verifies booking, vehicle and arrival. Record check-in instant and queue position
SM-02-04 — ROLE-006; Grace interval elapsed in branch calendar, branch was open. Record no-show reason; capacity/history retained
SM-02-05 — ROLE-006; Inspection handoff recorded. Complete visit without asserting sale or report approval
SM-03-01 — ROLE-007; All required points explicitly answered; unknown and N/A have reasons; clean evidence. Freeze submitted revision and assign independent reviewer
SM-03-02 — ROLE-008; Reviewer differs from author and provides point-level reasons. Create correction task; no published content changes
SM-03-03 — ROLE-008; Mandatory coverage passes template; reviewer independent; clean immutable evidence. Publish revision and emit inspection.report_published
SM-03-04 — ROLE-008; Reason, materiality and new revision recorded; existing report retained. Create successor revision; material change sets linked auction safety hold
SM-03-05 — ROLE-008; No active auction relies on draft; reason recorded. Retain audit and prevent publication
SM-04-01 — ROLE-021; Seller authority, rights-cleared media, condition and price fields complete. Freeze publication candidate separate from dealer report
SM-04-02 — ROLE-021; Publication grant; no active dealer-auction channel conflict. Publish only approved projection and invalidate search
SM-04-03 — ROLE-021; Ownership, condition or availability question documented. Remove from active search; preserve buyer inquiries
SM-04-04 — ROLE-021; Blocking issue resolved and authority still valid. Refresh public revision and searchable availability
SM-04-05 — ROLE-021; Completed transaction or independently verified external disposition. Display sold status; remove inquiry CTA
SM-04-06 — ROLE-021; Authorized owner request or legal reason. Unpublish with lifecycle SEO policy; retain audit
SM-05-01 — ROLE-009; Approved source rights, currency-consistent range, sufficient data and independent override reviewer. Pin input/report/rule versions and explanation
SM-05-02 — ROLE-009; Insufficient comparables or invalid inputs with reason. Publish abstention, never fabricate zero price
SM-05-03 — ROLE-009; New report/comparables or override reason; retain earlier valuation. Create successor valuation revision; active auctions unchanged
SM-06-01 — ROLE-010; Published report, seller authority, approved pinned rules, valid time interval, exclusive vehicle channel. Freeze schedule/rules/report snapshot and audience
SM-06-02 — SYSTEM-AUCTION; Trusted DB time reaches starts_at; report, vehicle and policy still valid. Emit auction.opened after commit
SM-06-03 — ROLE-010; Material safety issue or incident; recorded reason and case. Reject new bids, preserve deadline and bid history
SM-06-04 — ROLE-010; Safety issue resolved, prepublished policy allows resume and original deadline not passed. Record review, never reset or extend deadline silently
SM-06-05 — SYSTEM-AUCTION; DB time reaches deadline; same auction lock; paused/uncertain case yields pending_review result. Insert unique result and auction.closed atomically
SM-06-06 — ROLE-010; Authorized reason and approvals per pinned policy. Preserve all bids, cancel without automatic financial penalty
SM-08-01 — ROLE-019; Missing verification item specified. Notify applicant, preserve received evidence
SM-08-02 — ROLE-005; Authorized organization representative; clean evidence. Version submission and reset review assignment
SM-08-03 — ROLE-019; Independent reviewer verifies business and representative authority. Activate dealer account; do not grant every member bid authority
SM-08-04 — ROLE-019; Evidence-based reason and appeal instructions. Disable auction access, retain decision
SM-08-05 — ROLE-019; Risk/contract reason and case; step-up required. Lock same eligibility record used by bidding; revoke active feed subscriptions
SM-08-06 — ROLE-019; Independent risk review clears restriction. Restore eligible access prospectively; retain old decisions
SM-09-01 — ROLE-011; Available scoped advisor and authoritative listing check. Set owner and next contact due time
SM-09-02 — ROLE-011; Buyer needs and availability confirmed. Record requirements and next action; no reservation implied
SM-09-03 — ROLE-011; Buyer selects vehicle and appropriate contract path. Link transaction case; separate consumer/dealer paths
SM-09-04 — ROLE-003; Own request and obligations handled by legal case if necessary. Stop further optional sourcing; retain lawful evidence
SM-09-05 — ROLE-011; Transaction outcome or explicit unsuccessful disposition recorded. Record closure category; notify buyer
SM-10-01 — ROLE-003; Approved lender, explicit sharing basis and required application fields. Create provider intent, not credit approval
SM-10-06 — ROLE-003; Applicant request; contracted obligations escalated if already binding. Stop future optional sharing; retain required evidence
SM-11-01 — ROLE-012; Approved jurisdiction template, parties, amounts, fees and title process. Pin reviewed document checksum
SM-11-02 — ROLE-012; Required signers and authority verified; exact reviewed version unchanged. Issue signing invitations with expiring authorized access
SM-11-03 — ROLE-012; One verified signer on exact document hash; other required signers outstanding. Append signature evidence; never overwrite document
SM-11-04 — ROLE-012; All required valid signatures refer to same document hash. Emit contract.signed; does not imply settlement
SM-11-05 — ROLE-012; Approved legal basis and notice obligations recorded. Revoke unsigned invitations; preserve all signatures
SM-11-06 — ROLE-012; Authorized amendment process and newly executed successor. Retain old agreement linked to replacement
SM-12-01 — ROLE-013; Clean evidence references known payer/payee, source, amount and currency. Record claimed payment; no transfer or settled flag
SM-12-02 — ROLE-014; Independent matching confirms part of exact obligation. Record matched allocation and remaining balance
SM-12-03 — ROLE-014; Mismatch, duplicate allocation or uncertain finality. Assign exception and prohibit closure
SM-12-04 — ROLE-014; Independent reviewer, exact approved total, authentic source, no unresolved reversal. Record reconciliation and settlement.reconciled
SM-12-05 — ROLE-014; New authenticated reversal evidence. Append compensating fact, reopen financial exception; never erase history
SM-12-06 — ROLE-014; Underlying obligation legally cancelled; no unhandled payment. Preserve reason and source approval
SM-13-01 — ROLE-020; Qualified carrier, coverage, window and pickup authority. Share minimal job information with assigned carrier
SM-13-02 — ROLE-018; Pickup authority, condition, signed proof and custody verified. Append custody event and immutable condition evidence
SM-13-03 — ROLE-020; Carrier acceptance and destination details validated. Record dispatch and estimated window
SM-13-04 — ROLE-018; Authorized recipient proof, condition and time recorded. Record physical handover only
SM-13-05 — ROLE-020; Delay, damage or failed attempt has evidence and current custodian. Assign claims/dispatch owner; preserve custody
SM-13-06 — ROLE-020; New agreed window and verified custody/insurance. Create new attempt; retain failed attempt
SM-13-07 — ROLE-020; Vehicle not collected and authorized cancellation. Notify participants; no implied fee refund
SM-14-01 — ROLE-022; Applicable policy/version and missing evidence identified. Record next action and notice; original claim time retained
SM-14-02 — ROLE-022; Required evidence available; independent reviewer assigned. Preserve report, policy and transaction snapshots
SM-14-03 — ROLE-022; Coverage, liability and proposed remedy supported by approved policy. Create remedy proposal; finance separately authorizes money
SM-14-04 — ROLE-022; Reason and applicable appeal path supplied. Record reasoned decision without deleting evidence
SM-14-05 — ROLE-022; Authorized remedy completion independently confirmed. Close with remedy evidence and notification
SM-14-06 — ROLE-022; Appeal admissible under policy; independent new reviewer. Create linked review cycle; prior decision remains
SM-14-07 — ROLE-022; Applicable appeal handling completed. Record closure and evidence retention policy
SM-15-01 — ROLE-011; Available authorized team member. Set owner and response target
SM-15-02 — ROLE-011; Verified customer and minimum necessary case access. Record evidence request and investigation log
SM-15-03 — ROLE-011; Specific information request and follow-up date. Pause only approved resolution clock; not initial response
SM-15-04 — ROLE-011; Customer evidence received or staff follow-up. Resume clock and preserve waiting interval
SM-15-05 — ROLE-011; Reasoned resolution recorded; domain actions confirmed independently. Notify with appeal/reopen path
SM-15-06 — ROLE-011; Approved confirmation/closure policy satisfied. Record closure, no financial powers inferred
SM-15-07 — ROLE-011; New evidence or permitted customer request. Reopen with owner, preserve prior resolution
